description: This Java source file defines the Spring Boot configuration class 'ApplicationConfig' for the Hono Device Registry application. It sets up beans for Vert.x, OpenTracing Tracer, application properties, health check server, AMQP and REST endpoints, service properties, and security components, facilitating dependency injection and application setup.

classes.name: ApplicationConfig
classes.description: Spring Boot configuration class for setting up beans related to Vert.x, tracing, application properties, endpoints, metrics, health checks, and security for the Device Registry application.

methods.description: Creates and exposes a Vert.x instance configured with VertxProperties.

methods.description: Provides VertxProperties configured via application properties.

methods.description: Resolves and exposes an OpenTracing Tracer, defaulting to a no-op tracer if none is found.

methods.description: Provides general application configuration properties.
